title: 第6章 先别拉，有话好好说！
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: “坑爹啊，咋就换成闷罐子了？”“这玩意儿连个座儿都没有，黑咕隆咚的，也太憋屈了。”“我倒觉着挺好，把这包往地上一放，再往上一躺。多舒服，跟硬卧一样。”从原先站台下来后，新兵们将车厢让给了老百姓，在候车厅简单吃了个便饭，就被集体安排上了一辆闷罐子火车。所谓闷罐子，就是那种专门用来搬运货物，没有座椅，没有窗户，一节一节的铁皮车厢。得亏是晚上换乘，如果是白天，里头基本就和蒸笼一样，进去一会儿就得中暑。陆阳他们乘坐的这辆，后半截多是一些盖着迷彩布的大家伙，像是专门运送战车的。他听堂哥的战友科普过一些知识，部队在换装，演习等情况下，会用铁路来运输重装备。像坦克这样的履带式战车，还有大炮，装甲车，没法儿直接在路上跑；所以最方便快捷的方法，就是走铁路运输。只是天太黑，谁也没能看清后头那些盖着迷彩篷布的大家伙，到底长啥样？“班长，想撒尿。”忽然有人举起手，喊了一声。角落凳子上，正在那儿用手机偷菜的周凯东，头也不抬的指了指一侧的通风孔。“脱下裤子，枪口探出去直接尿。”“啊？”那个兵显然没料到，撒尿方式会如此粗暴直接。车厢里这么多人看着，相互之间还不太熟，他真拉不下这个脸。再加上，火车还在行进中，万一探头出去刮到树枝呢咋办？见这小子扭扭捏捏的，周凯东有些不耐烦的指向角落的红色塑料大桶。“尿那里头。”“好。”先前上车时候，大家还不知道角落这红色大桶是干啥的。现在可算是明白了，原来这就是给大家接尿用的。闷罐子不像绿皮火车，会在连接处设置厕所。在这里头想方便，要么“探头”尿在外面，要么尿在塑料瓶里，再要不就是这种事先准备好的小桶。淅淅沥沥的声音接二连三的传来，不少人都排着队去角落方便。尽管红桶配了个盖子，但因为车厢内空气不太流通，气味自然也就不怎么好闻。陆阳都把屁股往边上挪了挪，尽可能远离尿骚味的源头，但周凯东却像是司空见惯了一般，完全没有反应。忽然，陆阳似是想到什么，心底突然冒出一个非常不妙的念头：得亏只是尿尿，万一有人........“报告，肚子有点儿疼，想拉屎！”“不准！”周凯东干脆利落的拒绝了。开什么玩笑，这特么是闷罐子。尿骚味儿还稍微能忍忍，要是跑肚窜稀，接下来这段路谁能吃得消？周凯东站起身，走到那个兵面前：“你要真想拉，一会我把火车门打开，找俩人用背包绳拽着你，你就蹲在门边拉。”这是拉屎，还得耍杂技似，还得额外找俩人配合？关键这么整夜太危险了，万一一个没注意翻下去，那不完蛋了？见这个新兵被吓得瑟瑟发抖，疯狂摇头表示自已不想拉了，周凯东笑着拍拍他。“别紧张，中途火车会停靠，会给你们时间上大号，稍微忍忍。”“知，知道了。”话虽如此，但陆阳能够从周凯东的坏笑里看出，他是非常愿意看到那个兵挑战高难度的。毕竟火车在行进中拉开舱门，背对外头撅着腚，由多人配合着完成一次肠道清理工作，还是挺猎奇的。陆阳甚至怀疑，到时候周凯东很可能会掏出他那部山寨机，贱兮兮的疯狂拍照记录，然后在未来某一天来要挟这个新兵。“小子，你也不希望在铁路上拉野的照片，被其他人看到吧？”光是想想，陆阳就觉得浑身一阵恶寒，回头这个兵要是没有啥作为还好。万一有点儿什么成就，那这就是一辈子的阴影。周凯东见陆阳用异样眼神看着自已，故意冷笑着问了一句：“怎么，你也肚子痛，也想挑战一把高难度？”陆阳疯狂摇头：“没有没有，一切良好。”【检测到新知识点：火车拉野屎！】【知识点分析......过程中可对括约肌，腿部肌肉，核心稳定提供x2倍速提升！】陆阳眼睛一瞪，直接将系统面板叉掉！这玩意儿，谁他妈爱学谁学，反正老子不学！......火车轰隆隆的还在前进着，具体到哪儿了陆阳也不清楚。或许是实在闲的有些无聊，相互之间又有人开始聊起天。坐在陆阳对面那个身形健硕，模样形似卤蛋的新兵主动开口搭话。“哥们儿，先前路上，见你看书看一路，这会儿咋不看书了？”“光线太暗，对眼睛不好。”“也对。我叫孔垄，东北人，家里开饭馆的，你呢？”“你确定，你们家开的是饭馆，不是武馆？”陆阳的话，直接给孔垄逗乐了。同样的军装，穿在陆阳身上空荡荡，到了孔垄身上则像是小了一号。孔垄解释说，健身纯属个人兴趣爱好，接着便自豪的向陆阳展示了下他浮夸的胸大肌，以及43的臂围。陆阳夸了句牛逼，也自我介绍： “我叫陆阳，广陵人，就是普通家庭。”“广陵？”“烟花三月，下广陵，南方小城市。”“哦~~~”孔垄顿时露出一副意味深长的笑容，配合上他这副形似卤蛋外貌，多少带着点儿猥琐。陆阳尴尬的摸了摸鼻子，觉得他一定是误会什么了。这里的烟花三月，并非是烟花巷的意思。算了，不解释了，越描越黑。谁让乾隆康熙那帮家伙，有事没事就喜欢下江南，还格外钟意“广陵瘦马”。这也导致外地一部分外地人，对于李白诗里的“烟花三月下广陵”产生一定误解。孔垄：“哥们儿，回头咱们要是能分到一个地方，我带你练练肌肉？你这细胳膊细腿的，得加强锻炼啊。”“不用了。”“为啥？”“因为.......”陆阳犹豫了一下，还是好意提醒：“部队里，极少数会有你这种块头的肌肉，大多数都是薄肌，就是穿上衣服看不大出来的那种。”孔垄挠挠头：“这话怎么说？”陆阳解释：“你健身的目的，是为了塑形，为了美观，甚至是为了参加健美比赛。但部队里的肌肉，讲究实用。”“块头越大，动作相对就会变得迟缓，尤其是在有氧运动时，你的负担也会更重。”“同样跑三千米，我这个瘦子勉勉强强能跑完，因为我自身负重小。但对你来说，就是额外负重了几十斤。”“最后，你是不是不爱练腿......”
content_en: "What a rip-off, why did you change it to a sleeper train?" "This thing doesn't even have a seat, and it's so dark. It's so frustrating." "I thought it was good, so I put the bag on the ground and lay down on it. It's so comfortable, just like a hard sleeper." After getting off the original platform, the recruits gave the carriage to the ordinary people, had a simple meal in the waiting hall, and then were collectively arranged to board a sleeper train.The so-called stuffy can is the kind of iron car that is specially used to carry goods. It has no seats and no windows and is built one section at a time.Fortunately, we transfer at night. If it is during the day, the inside is basically the same as a steamer. You will suffer from heatstroke after entering it.The back half of the car that Lu Yang and the others were riding in was mostly made up of big guys covered with camouflage cloth, as if they were specially used to transport tanks.He heard some knowledge from his cousin's comrades. The troops would use railways to transport heavy equipment when changing equipment, conducting exercises, etc.Tracked combat vehicles such as tanks, as well as artillery and armored vehicles, cannot run directly on the road; so the most convenient and fastest way is to transport them by rail.It's just that it was too dark, and no one could see clearly what those big guys covered with camouflage tarpaulins behind them looked like."Squad leader, I want to pee." Suddenly someone raised his hand and shouted.On the stool in the corner, Zhou Kaidong, who was using his mobile phone to steal food, pointed to the ventilation hole on one side without raising his head."Take off your pants, stick out the muzzle of the gun and pee directly." "Huh?" The soldier obviously didn't expect that the peeing method would be so rough and direct.There were so many people in the carriage looking at each other, and they were not very familiar with each other. He really couldn't bear to look like this.In addition, the train is still moving. What if I stick my head out and scrape a branch?Seeing the boy's coyness, Zhou Kaidong pointed to the red plastic bucket in the corner impatiently."Pee in there." "Okay." When we got on the bus, everyone didn't know what the big red bucket in the corner was for.Now I understand, it turns out that this is for everyone to pee.Unlike the green train, the stuffy jar will have toilets at the connections.For convenience here, you can either pee outside with a "probe", or pee in a plastic bottle, or else use a small bucket prepared in advance.The pattering sounds came one after another, and many people lined up to go to the corner for convenience.Although the red bucket is equipped with a lid, the smell is naturally not very good because the air in the car is not well circulated.Lu Yang moved his butt to the side, trying to stay away from the source of the smell of urine, but Zhou Kaidong seemed to be used to it and didn't react at all.Suddenly, Lu Yang seemed to have thought of something, and a very bad thought suddenly appeared in his heart: Fortunately, he was just peeing, what if someone... "Report, my stomach hurts a little, and I want to poop!" "No!" Zhou Kaidong simply refused.Are you kidding? This is a boring jar.The smell of urine is somewhat tolerable, but if I run into diarrhea, who can bear it for the rest of the journey?Zhou Kaidong stood up and walked to the soldier: "If you really want to pull it, I will open the train door and find two people to pull you with a backpack rope, and you squat by the door to pull it." This is shitting, and it has to be acrobatic. Do you need two extra people to cooperate?The key point is that it's too dangerous to stay up all night. What if someone doesn't pay attention and flips over?Seeing that the recruit was shaking with fear and shaking his head wildly to express that he didn't want to pull him anymore, Zhou Kaidong smiled and patted him."Don't be nervous. The train will stop on the way and I will give you time to play the big game. Just be patient." "I know, I know." Even so, Lu Yang could see from Zhou Kaidong's evil smile that he was very willing to see that soldier challenge the difficult challenge.After all, it is quite novel to open the hatch of the train while it is moving, with its back to the outside and to have its butt raised, and for multiple people to complete an intestinal cleansing task.Lu Yang even suspected that Zhou Kaidong would probably take out his copycat phone, take crazy photos and records, and then blackmail the recruit one day in the future."Boy, you don't want the photos of the gangster on the railway to be seen by others, right?" Just thinking about it, Lu Yang felt a chill running through his body. It would be better if this soldier did nothing.If there is any achievement, it will be a lifelong shadow.Zhou Kaidong saw Lu Yang looking at him with a strange look, and deliberately sneered and asked: "Why, you also have a stomachache, and you want to challenge a difficult challenge?" Lu Yang shook his head crazily: "No, no, everything is fine." [New knowledge point detected: Trains poop wildly!】【Analysis of knowledge points... During the process, it can provide x2 speed improvement to the sphincter, leg muscles, and core stability!] Lu Yang glared and cut off the system panel!Whoever wants to learn this thing can learn it, but I won’t learn it anyway!...The train was still rumbling forward, and Lu Yang didn't know exactly where it was.Maybe they were just a little bored, so someone started chatting with each other.The muscular recruit sitting opposite Lu Yang, who looked like a braised egg, took the initiative to talk to him."Brother, I saw you reading a book on the road earlier. Why don't you read now?" "The light is too dark, which is not good for the eyes." "That's right. My name is Kong Long, from the Northeast. My family runs a restaurant. What about you?" "Are you sure your family runs a restaurant, not a martial arts gym?" Lu Yang's words directly amused Kong Long.The same military uniform looked empty on Lu Yang, but looked one size smaller on Kong Long.Kong Long explained that fitness was purely a personal hobby, and then he proudly showed Lu Yang his exaggerated pectoralis major muscles and 43cm arm circumference.Lu Yang praised his awesomeness and introduced himself: "My name is Lu Yang, from Guangling, just an ordinary family." "Guangling?" "Fireworks in March, down to Guangling, a small city in the south." "Oh~~~" Kong Long suddenly showed a meaningful smile, which matched his appearance of a braised egg, which was a bit wretched.Lu Yang touched his nose awkwardly, feeling that he must have misunderstood something.Fireworks here in March does not mean Fireworks Alley.Forget it, I won’t explain it anymore, it’s getting darker and darker.Who made Qianlong and Kangxi's gang like to go to the south of the Yangtze River whenever they had something to do? They also particularly liked the "Guangling thin horse".This has also led to some misunderstandings among some outsiders about "Fireworks Falling in Guangling in March" in Li Bai's poem.Kong Long: "Brother, if we can be assigned to a place later, I will take you to train your muscles? You have thin arms and legs, you need to strengthen your training." "No need." "Why?" "Because..." Lu Yang hesitated, but kindly reminded: "There are very few muscles of your size in the army, and most of them are thin muscles, the kind that can't be seen clearly when wearing clothes." Kong Long scratched his head: "How do you say this?" Lu Yang explained: "The purpose of your fitness is to get in shape, to look good, and even to participate in bodybuilding competitions.But the muscles in the army are more practical.""The bigger you are, the slower your movements will be, especially during aerobic exercise." "Similarly, I can barely run three thousand meters because I carry a small weight." "Finally, don't you like to train your legs..."
